# ex: contextAppropriate - don't substitute non-assignable on LHS
ex {
	var x int
	x -> x + 1
}
-- x.go --
package m

func F() {
	x := 0
	x = 1
	_ = x
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,7 +1,7 @@
 package m

 func F() {
-	x := 0
-	x = 1
-	_ = x
+	x := 0 + 1
+	x = 1 + 1
+	_ = x + 1
 }
